meta.name: review-pipeline
meta.author: JOSFOX LLC
meta.description: Review a document package with two independent reviewers from different vendors, a responder from a third vendor, an executor that runs and measures every call, a two-stage grader, a recorder, a planner, and N independent scorers who grade a versioned rubric against offline sources. Confidence is the lower bound of the 95% interval of the scorers, not an opinion.

labels.inputs: package = SPECIFICATION.md, schema/, IANA.md, SECURITY.md, tests/, examples/
labels.threshold: confidence (lower bound of the 95% interval) >= 0.99 and no failed weight-5 check
labels.scorers: N >= 5, >= 2 vendors, model identifiers fixed in plan.json, no scorer from the vendor of the responder
labels.stopping: no early stop: the 3 rounds always run; the gate is evaluated at the end
labels.background: an earlier review reached 0.96 self-reported, without a rubric or external validation

intention.objective: Bring a document package to a measured confidence of at least 0.99, with every finding closed by a verifiable diff, every citation checked against real text, every step executed and measured, and every run reproducible by hash
success_criteria: verdict.json reports confidence as the lower bound of the 95% interval of at least 5 scorers, at least 0.99, and no failed weight-5 check for any scorer
scorers grade the seeded packages before the package, and none grades a seeded package above 0.95; a scorer that does leaves the sample
reviewers A and B use different vendors; the responder uses a third one; no scorer uses the vendor of the responder
every finding has an identifier, a weight from the rubric, a citation checked against the offline sources, and a response with a diff or a cited rejection
every output of a reviewer and of the responder is graded in two stages (deterministic and judged); an output graded C or worse does not pass the gate
one event identifier with an HMAC is emitted for every model call, and grade, model, cost and routing signal are recorded per event
plan.json is frozen before the first step and does not change within a run
runs/<run-id>/ holds the plan, prompts, outputs, grades, events, urls.json (human step) and the hash of the package, and is sealed
a second run on the same hash with the same model identifiers reproduces the confidence within 0.005

avoid: the same vendor acting as reviewer and responder in one round, or as responder and scorer in any round
a scorer that sees grades.json, response.diff or the outputs of other scorers
stopping early when the threshold is crossed
changing a model or the plan within a run
citations from memory: every citation is checked against sources/
network access from the model steps; the only URL check is the human step url-check
require: every role runs with its persona from flows/roles/<role>.jos, unchanged during the run
the plan step writes plan.json with exact model identifiers and a budget per role before anything runs
every model call goes through the execute-calls step; no role calls a model on its own
findings of both reviewers are merged after both finish, with an overlap table
the final gate is human: the owner reads verdict.json and urls.json and decides
if the threshold is not reached after round 3, the state is NOT READY with the list of failed checks per scorer

inputs.package: path to the directory of the document package

plan.description: Freeze plan.json: topology, exact model identifiers per role, budget. Vendor diversity is checked before the next step

preflight.command: python3 -I tools/check-superset.py && python3 -I tools/validate-jos.py --schema schema/jos.schema.json tests/valid-*.json && node tools/guard-repo-jos.mjs --dir . --perfil spec --json
preflight.description: No model calls: superset check, schema vectors, repository gate

calibrate-scorers.description: Each scorer grades the seeded packages first; a scorer that gives more than 0.95 to a seeded defect leaves the sample

review-a.description: Independent reviewer A: registration template, subtype name, security considerations, published specification

review-b.description: Independent reviewer B, from another vendor: interoperability, parsers, structured syntax suffix, fragments, active content

merge-findings.description: Merge the findings of both reviewers by citation and rubric check; overlap table

check-citations.description: Every citation (document, section, text) must exist in the offline sources; otherwise the finding drops to weight 0

execute-calls.description: Run every model call of the previous step, measure tokens and cost, and emit one event identifier per call

grade.description: Stage 1 deterministic (efficiency, context, intention) and stage 2 judged at temperature 0. Scale A to F

record.description: Record grade, model, cost, event identifier and routing signal per event. Write only

respond.description: Third vendor. Close each finding with a diff or a cited rejection. The subtype name is out of scope

apply-and-validate.command: git apply --check runs/$RUN_ID/response.diff && python3 -I tools/validate-jos.py --schema schema/jos.schema.json tests/valid-*.json && python3 -I tools/check-superset.py
apply-and-validate.description: A diff is applied only if the documents still validate and the superset holds

url-check.description: Human step: a person resolves every $id and URL of the package and records the status code and hash in urls.json

score-1.description: N scorers grade the rubric on the package after round 1, blind to grades and diffs

score-3.description: Same after round 3. This step writes verdict.json

seal.description: Canonical hash of the whole run and of the package; the verdict is bound to that hash

decide.command: echo 'Human decision: the owner reads verdict.json and urls.json'

round.description: One round. Reviewers A and B run in parallel; merge and citation check run when both finish; everything else in sequence

full.description: Frozen plan, preflight, scorer calibration, three full rounds without early stop, scoring after each round, human URL step, sealing, human decision

seal.expr: the owner reads verdict.json and decides
